# Gridfinity Kitchen (OpenSCAD files)

Kitchen bins with a full-width or edge wall cutout and drawer spacers, built on a 2024-02-17 snapshot of ostat's Gridfinity Extended basic cup (MIT at that time; see LICENSE.txt). Each `gridfinity_kitchen_*.scad` file is a preset of the same generator.

- Source: ZIP supplied by the repository owner on 2026-10-03; files kept byte-for-byte.
- Gridfinity Extended: https://www.printables.com/model/630057-gridfinity-extended-openscad

## Added file

`modules/module_gridfinity_cup_base_text.scad` was referenced but missing from the ZIP. It is copied unmodified from ostat/gridfinity_extended_openscad at commit `ee7d25f` (2024-11-26, MIT), the upstream commit whose 30 module files match the ZIP's byte-for-byte (ignoring line endings). The README's file hash in `sources/SHA256SUMS` was recorded before this note was added and is updated with it.
